score_formula: 100 * sum(w_i * d_i for observed i) / sum(w_i for observed i) / 2, with d_i in {-2,-1,+1,+2}
current_stance_formula: decay-weighted average of agreed event scores in the 90-day window; weight = 0.5 ** (days / 30)
structural_lean_formula: equal-weighted average of agreed event scores in 2025-05-20..as-of; published only if at least 4 agreed events and at least 365 days between first and last
disagreement_rule: Pass A and Pass B must match on the sign of the event score and on every observed dimension, and coverage must differ by less than 20 percentage points. Otherwise do not average. A reasoned third pass may resolve a disagreement if 2 of 3 readings agree; if it stays close, mark unresolved and exclude.
roster_as_of: FOMC membership page last update 18 November 2026; Board members page last update 28 May 2026; district pages last updates between 5 February and 14 October 2026; all retrieved 20 November 2026.
vacancies: No vacancy on the seven-member Board. Atlanta presidency is filled on an interim basis by Cheryl Venable. No other interim or acting presidents on the 12 official district pages.
vorbehalte: Weights (40/20/20/10/10), camp thresholds (±20), alert thresholds (15 / 25 points) and the 30-day half-life are proposed model parameters and are not validated (nicht validiert / not validated).

Structural lean is the equal-weighted average of agreed event scores in the 12–18 month window 20 May 2025 to 20 November 2026. It is published only when there are at least 4 agreed scored policy events and at least 365 days between the first and last of those events. Shorter official tenure (Warsh as Chair from 22 May 2026; Venable as Interim Atlanta President, first official message 12 May 2026) is labelled insufficient evidence even if a current stance can be computed.

Current stance is the 90-day decay-weighted average of agreed event scores (half-life 30 days). A current-stance camp is printed only when a published stance exists and at least one agreed event in that 90-day window has an observed preferred-rate-path dimension (same rule as Phase 2). That camp is not a structural classification.
The public camp field is the structural classification (Hawk / Centrist / Dove / insufficient evidence). Current stance and its camp are shown alongside it.

Phase-2 events keep their original independent Pass A and Pass B. A reasoned third pass was run on the seven Phase-2 disagreements. Five were resolved by 2-of-3 agreement and are included with recomputed scores. Two (Schmid 15.11.2026 and Barkin 9.11.2026) remain nicht aufgelöst / unresolved and are excluded from calculations.

Phase 3.1 is a delta rerun that two-pass scored remaining policy-relevant official texts already stored under phase3/raw/ for 20 May 2025–20 November 2026. No new crawl was run. Two FOMC statements (17 June and 16 September 2026) were re-fetched with curl only to confirm the official 12-0 votes; no missed dissents were found. Pass A and Pass B were coded from the same official verbatim quotes with a conservative rubric (conditional scenarios are not a baseline path; missing dimensions stay not_observed, never 0). They agree where that official language is explicit. Identical or near-verbatim repeat speeches and official dissent explainers already scored in v3 were treated as syndication and excluded from the calculations. Official texts with no observed dimension, and non-policy official texts, are listed internally and are not in the public events table.

Every scored quote used in site_data_v3_1 is verbatim from an official Board or Reserve Bank page, official PDF, or FOMC statement stored in this package. Licensed-press wording is not in site_data_v3_1. Interviews without an official transcript remain unconfirmed and are not scored. A primary-source date correction was applied to one Kansas City speech: the stored filename used 12 November 2026, but the official datePublished is 18 September 2026.

Speeches without monetary-policy path or stance content stay out of the public events table. Missing dimensions are coded 'not observed', never 0. Allowed dimension codes are {-2,-1,+1,+2} or not_observed.

Event scores use observed dimensions only, with weights renormalised and then scaled by 1/2 to the -100..+100 range. A single observed dimension therefore renormalises to ±50 or ±100. Coverage and confidence are published with the score.

2026 voter status is taken from the official FOMC membership page (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc.htm, last update 18 November 2026). The seven Board seats are filled (no vacancy). Cheryl Venable is Interim President of the Atlanta Fed. Sushmita Shukla is listed as a 2026 alternate (New York First Vice President) but is not a president and is not scored. Primary-source dates are used throughout.
Relative shift is a diagnostic (own latest-vs-baseline change minus the median change of peers), not a causal estimate.
Panel A bubble size is the number of official, policy-relevant, verbatim-text evidence items that were two-pass scored and agreed in this package, not a market-influence weight.

No FRED or other API key, and no licensed dataset, is in this package. Firecrawl was not used in Phase 3 (all fetches were curl to official sites). Phase-1/2 Firecrawl use for a few official St. Louis Fed pages remains documented there.

A successful run of the scoring script proves that the arithmetic identities were executed, not that the dimension codes are financially or institutionally 'correct'. Dimension codes are analyst-style judgments from stored official text. The later validation workstream in the Phase-1 build plan has not been run.
